annotations.title: Generate GovCon Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP), PRS Table & PWS SLA/KPI Matrix

description: Transform Performance Work Statement (PWS), Statement of Work (SOW), or Statement of Objectives (SOO) deliverables into a FAR Subpart 37.6 Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) package containing a 0-100 QASP Readiness Score, an executive surveillance summary, a Performance Requirements Summary (PRS) Table (with PWS section reference, performance objective, measurable KPI standard, Acceptable Quality Level [AQL], FAR 46.4 surveillance method, monitoring frequency, positive/negative incentive or invoice deduction formula, and assigned COR/QA role), automated SLA/KPI telemetry metrics, a closed-loop Non-Conformance & Cure Notice Corrective Action Report (CAR) workflow with FAR 52.246 inspection citations, and a ready-to-submit QASP/QCP proposal narrative. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive quality engineering and proposal generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `pws_or_sow_deliverables_text` accepts 30 to 75,000 characters, while `contract_type_and_incentive_structure` and `surveillance_rigor_and_mission_criticality` calibrate AQL thresholds and incentive/deduction mechanics across FFP, T&M, CPAF, CPIF, and Hybrid IDIQ task orders). Use this tool when building a FAR 37.6 Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP), Performance Requirements Summary (PRS) matrix, or Contractor Quality Control Plan (QCP) with AQLs and SLA deduction formulas; use `generate_compliance_matrix` instead to shred general Section C/L/M `shall`/`must` requirements into a proposal outline, or `generate_rfp_response` to draft general Technical Approach prose.

contract_type_and_incentive_structure.description: Contract type and incentive structure ('Firm_Fixed_Price_FFP' [default], 'Time_and_Materials_TM', 'Cost_Plus_Award_Fee_CPAF', 'Cost_Plus_Incentive_Fee_CPIF', or 'Hybrid_IDIQ_Task_Order') used to calibrate FAR 52.246 inspection clauses and AQL incentive/deduction formulas.

pws_or_sow_deliverables_text.description: Raw Performance Work Statement (PWS), Statement of Work (SOW), or Statement of Objectives (SOO) tasks, service levels, and deliverable requirements (30 to 75,000 characters).

surveillance_rigor_and_mission_criticali.description: Mission criticality and surveillance rigor profile ('Mission_Critical_24x7_Zero_Trust' [default], 'Standard_Enterprise_IT_SLA', or 'R_and_D_Agile_DevSecOps').

name: generate_quality_assurance_qasp

executive_surveillance_summary.description: Executive summary of the FAR 37.6 surveillance strategy, ISO 9001 / CMMI Level 3 quality governance, and COR partnership model.

non_conformance_and_cure_notice_workflow.description: Closed-loop Non-Conformance, Corrective Action Report (CAR), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective Action Plan (CAP), and FAR 52.246 inspection workflow.

performance_requirements_summary_prs_tab.description: Structured FAR Subpart 37.6 Performance Requirements Summary (PRS) rows with objectives, KPI standards, AQLs, surveillance methods, and incentive/deduction formulas.

qasp_readiness_score.description: 0-100 score quantifying the measurability, FAR Subpart 37.6 compliance, and audit defensibility of the QASP and PRS matrix.

ready_to_submit_qasp_narrative.description: Complete, paste-ready Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) & Quality Control Plan (QCP) proposal volume narrative in Markdown.

sla_and_kpi_telemetry_metrics.description: Automated SLA and KPI telemetry metrics with target thresholds, measurement windows, data sources, and breach escalation triggers.
